correctness.rationale: Starting from the actual equal-community pure-triangle two-dimensional field, exact s=(x+y)/2,d=(x−y)/2 reduction gives d²=s²[2ε(1−s)−1]/[ε(1−2s)], λ=[2εs((1−s)²−d²)]⁻¹ at every unequal interior equilibrium. Positivity restricts 1/2<ε<1 and 0<s<1−1/(2ε)<1/2. Independently recomputed symbolic Jacobian gives trace T/D, determinant [2ε(1−s)−1]P/D², with P=ε(12s³−17s²+8s−1)+4s³−3s²; the exact polynomial identities cancel to zero. On the potentially stable interval P>0 iff ε>F(s)=s²(3−4s)/(12s³−17s²+8s−1), whose unique minimum at s=(3−√3)/4 equals (9+24√3)/61. Verified the sum-of-squares positivity used to force negative trace; at ε=9/10,s=1/3, the witness trace is −1 and determinant 6/25. Hyperbolic local only; equality nonhyperbolic, λ selected as needed, and other contagion models are excluded.
